name: Martial Arts Club Manager
author: madebyeli

sections.description:
Martial Arts Club Manager is a comprehensive WordPress plugin designed specifically for martial arts club owners, dojo managers, and gym operators who need a professional system to manage their students, classes, and operations.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Karate dojos and martial arts schools
  • Taekwondo, Judo, Jiu-Jitsu, and other martial arts clubs
  • Fitness centers offering martial arts classes
  • Sports clubs needing member and class management
  • Any organization requiring attendance tracking and membership management

Free Features

Member Management
* Add unlimited members to user accounts
* Detailed member profiles with photo, belt color, weight, height
* Basic membership type management
* Member status management (active/inactive)
* Date of birth and personal information tracking
* Export member data to CSV
* “By User” view that groups members under their family account, with bulk actions: set active/inactive, change membership, assign belt, send email and export
* Printable membership cards

Belt Colors
* Set up your own belt colors and their order
* Activate or deactivate several belts at once with bulk actions

Trial Class Booking
* Public booking form for prospective students
* Admin notification emails with applicant details
* Customizable success messages
* Manage trial bookings from admin panel
* Track each booking from pending to contacted, confirmed and completed
* Bulk actions: mark several bookings contacted, confirmed, completed, cancelled or pending, or delete them
* Convert trial students to members easily

WooCommerce Integration
* Associate members with product purchases
* Mark products as “dojo products” requiring member selection
* Display member information in cart and checkout
* Seamless integration with WooCommerce workflows
* Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage and the Cart and Checkout blocks

Admin Dashboard (Basic)
* Member list with sorting and filtering
* Belt distribution analytics
* Membership type breakdown
* Recent members view
* Recent trial bookings
* Settings and customization
* WordPress dashboard widgets: upcoming member birthdays, membership overview and members by belt color
* Warns you if your site timezone is missing or set to a fixed offset, which would shift class times when the clocks change

Frontend Member Area
* View and edit member profiles
* Upload member photos
* Manage personal information
* Access member cards

Data Tools
* Export your club data as a full JSON backup or as CSV files
* Import a backup into the same or another site, with options for matching users and handling duplicates
* Reset plugin data to start again

Pro Features (Premium License)

Advanced Member Management
* Multi-club support for franchise operations
* Group assignments for organizing students
* License expiration tracking with automated reminders
* Belt grading history tracking
* Club and group filtering in member lists
* Belt color groups: limit belts to groups such as Kids or Adults, and add or remove belts from groups in bulk
* Assign groups and enroll in classes from the “By User” view

Class Scheduling & Management 🔒
* Create and manage unlimited classes
* Schedule classes by day, time, and location
* Weekly, every-other-week and monthly classes
* Classes that run past midnight
* Multi-day classes that share one roster
* Multiple location support
* Assign groups to specific classes
* Enroll members in classes
* Class capacity management, with a waitlist that promotes members automatically when a place opens
* Archive old classes while preserving history
* Bulk actions: archive or restore classes, assign or remove instructors, and change location

Kiosk Sign-In 🔒
* Full-screen tablet sign-in for your dojo entrance
* Members sign in by searching their name, with a 6-digit PIN, or by scanning their personal QR code
* QR codes on printed membership cards and in the Member Area
* Instructor Mode for signing in a whole class and reopening sign-in for a class that is running late
* Late Sign-In Grace setting controls how long after a class ends students can still sign in

Instructors & Private Bookings 🔒
* Instructor profiles with photos, assigned to classes
* Activate or deactivate instructors in bulk
* Instructor availability with weekly slots and date-specific changes
* Public booking form for private lessons, with payment through WooCommerce or admin confirmation

Syllabus & Grading Progress 🔒
* Publish grading requirements for each belt, with descriptions, videos and PDFs
* Instructors sign off each requirement for each member
* Members see their own syllabus and progress on any page you add the syllabus to

Activity Log 🔒
* See who changed what and when: members, belts, groups, attendance, kiosk sign-ins, trial bookings, bulk actions and imports
* Filter by date, area, person or member, and export to CSV
* Choose how long entries are kept
* Works with WordPress’s personal data export and erase tools

Attendance Tracking 🔒
* Quick attendance recording for each class
* View and modify historical attendance records
* Comprehensive attendance reports
* Export attendance data to CSV
* Filter by class, member, or date range
* Attendance trends analytics (6 months)

Events Management 🔒
* Create and manage martial arts events (tournaments, seminars, gradings)
* Multiple member registration per event
* Registration closing dates
* Event status tracking (upcoming, ongoing, completed)
* Email notifications for registrations
* Export event registrations to CSV
* Archive events when complete
* Member event history tracking

Training Videos 🔒
* Organize training videos by belt level
* Filter videos by category, difficulty, and instructor
* Restrict access based on membership type
* Video thumbnail and description support
* YouTube and Vimeo integration
* Progress tracking

Communication Tools 🔒
* Send bulk emails to all members or filtered groups
* Filter recipients by membership type, group, or status
* Email preview before sending
* Customizable email templates with header/footer
* Button color customization for branded emails

Page Access Control 🔒
* Restrict pages to logged-in users only
* Set membership-level restrictions
* Create premium content areas
* Custom redirect rules

Enhanced Dashboard 🔒
* Active classes statistics
* Monthly attendance overview
* Upcoming events widget
* Expiring licenses alerts
* Attendance trends chart
* Advanced analytics

Requirements

This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active. WooCommerce is used for handling product purchases and member associations during checkout.

Language Support

  • Fully internationalized and translation-ready
  • Text domain: martial-arts-club-manager
  • POT file included for translators

Documentation

The full user manual is online at https://www.martialartsclubmanager.com/user-documentation/ and is linked from the plugin’s dashboard (View Documentation).

Support

For support and questions, please visit the WordPress.org support forums for this plugin.

For bug reports, please include:
* WordPress version
* WooCommerce version
* PHP version
* Description of the issue
* Steps to reproduce

Credits

Martial Arts Club Manager is developed and maintained by madebyeli.com.

Privacy Policy

Martial Arts Club Manager stores member information in your WordPress database. This information includes:
* Member names and contact details
* Date of birth
* Belt colors and membership information
* Attendance records
* Event registrations
* Trial booking requests

All data is stored locally on your WordPress installation. The plugin does not send any data to external servers. You are responsible for complying with privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) in your jurisdiction.

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with:
* WooCommerce (required) – For product purchases and checkout
* YouTube/Vimeo (optional) – For embedding training videos (if you use the training videos feature)

When using training videos with embedded YouTube or Vimeo content, those platforms may collect data according to their privacy policies. Please review YouTube and Vimeo privacy policies if you use this feature.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Martial Arts Club Manager”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Important: Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active first

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Click “Choose File” and select the downloaded ZIP
  5. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  6. Important: Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active first

After Activation

  1. Go to “Martial Arts Club” in the WordPress admin menu
  2. Visit Settings to configure your preferences
  3. Set up your first members under “Members”
  4. Create your class schedule under “Classes”
  5. Start tracking attendance!

Configuration Steps

Step 1: Configure Basic Settings
* Navigate to Martial Arts → Settings
* Set your date and time formats
* Configure email settings (from name, from email; premium)
* Customize button colors for frontend forms

Step 2: Set Up Configuration Entities
* Review Belt Colors (a default set is created for you; add, rename or reorder them to match your style)
* Add Locations where classes are held (premium)
* Add Groups to organize members (beginners, intermediate, advanced, etc.; premium)
* Add your Membership Types (none are created for you)

Step 3: Add Members
* Go to Martial Arts → Members
* Click “Add Member”
* Fill in member details (name, DOB, belt color, group, etc.)
* Upload member photo (optional)
* Assign membership type

Step 4: Create Class Schedule
* Go to Martial Arts → Classes
* Click “Add Class”
* Set class name, day, time, and location
* Assign which groups can attend
* Save the class

Step 5: Enroll Members in Classes
* Go to Martial Arts → Classes
* Click “Enrollments” for a specific class
* Select members to enroll using checkboxes
* Save enrollments

Step 6: Set Up WooCommerce Products (Optional)
* Go to Products in WooCommerce
* Edit any product that should require member association
* Tick “Dojo Product” in the product data section
* When customers purchase, they’ll select which member the product is for
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, absolutely. Martial Arts Club Manager requires WooCommerce to be installed and active. WooCommerce handles the product purchase workflows and member associations during checkout.

Can I use this without WooCommerce?

No. If WooCommerce is not active, the plugin will automatically deactivate and display a notice. WooCommerce is a core dependency for this plugin’s functionality.

How many members can I add?

There is no limit. You can add as many members as your club needs.

Can multiple members share one user account?

Yes! This is actually the recommended approach. Parents can have one user account and add all their children as members. Each member has their own profile, attendance tracking, and class enrollments.

How do I track attendance?

Attendance tracking is a premium feature. Instructors take attendance on the Class Register page on your site: choose a class and date, tick the members who attended, and save. Choosing an earlier date lets you correct past attendance. Members can also sign themselves in at the kiosk. In the admin area, Martial Arts → Attendance lets you view records, generate reports, clear records and choose who can use the Class Register. Requires premium license.

Can I export attendance data?

Yes, with a premium license. Go to Martial Arts → Attendance → Generate Report and select your filters (class, date range, member). Click “Export to CSV” to download attendance data in spreadsheet format. Requires premium license.

What membership types are included?

The plugin doesn’t create any default membership types. You have complete flexibility to create your own custom membership types that match your club’s needs (e.g., Monthly, Quarterly, Annual, Student, Family, etc.). Create and manage membership types under Martial Arts → Membership Types.

How do training videos work?

Training videos are a premium feature. Add videos under Martial Arts → Training Videos, set the belt level, category, and difficulty, then embed YouTube or Vimeo URLs. You can limit the videos page to members with a chosen membership type. Users access videos via a frontend page. Requires premium license.

Can I organize members into groups?

Yes, with a premium license! Groups are perfect for organizing members by skill level (beginners, intermediate, advanced) or age (kids, teens, adults). Create groups under Martial Arts → Groups, then assign members to groups in their profiles. Requires premium license.

How do events work?

Events are a premium feature for special occasions like tournaments, seminars, belt gradings, or workshops. Create an event under Martial Arts → Events, set the date and registration closing date. Users can register multiple members for events. You’ll receive email notifications for each registration. Requires premium license.

Can parents register their kids for events?

Yes, with a premium license! When a user clicks “Register” on an event, they see a list of all their members with checkboxes. They can select one or multiple members to register for the event. Requires premium license.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

When you uninstall (delete) the plugin through WordPress, all plugin data is permanently removed including database tables, member information, attendance records, and settings. This cannot be undone. If you only deactivate the plugin, all data is preserved.

Is there a pro version?

Yes! The plugin offers both free and premium versions. The free version includes essential member management, trial bookings, and basic dashboard features. The premium version unlocks advanced features like class scheduling, attendance tracking, events management, training videos, bulk emails, and more. Upgrade to Pro directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Where can I get support?

For support, please use the WordPress.org support forums. Check the user manual first – open it from View Documentation on the Martial Arts dashboard, or go to https://www.martialartsclubmanager.com/user-documentation/.

Can I customize the button colors?

Yes! Go to Martial Arts → Settings → Button Colours. You can set gradient colors for all frontend buttons (trial booking, member area, etc.) to match your branding.

How do I set up the trial class booking form?

The trial booking form is automatically created when you activate the plugin. A page called “Book a Trial Class” is added to your site. Share this page with prospective students, and you’ll receive email notifications when someone books a trial.

Can members sign themselves in at the dojo?

Yes, with a premium license. Kiosk Mode turns a tablet at your entrance into a sign-in screen. Members search for their name, enter their 6-digit PIN, or scan their personal QR code, and their attendance is recorded against the class you selected. Instructors can switch to Instructor Mode to sign in a whole class at once. Set it up under Martial Arts → Kiosk Mode. Requires premium license.

Can I see who changed a member’s details?

Yes, with a premium license. The Activity Log under Martial Arts → Activity Log records who changed members, belts, groups, attendance, kiosk sign-ins and trial bookings, and when. Only administrators can see it. You can filter it, export it to CSV and choose how long entries are kept. Requires premium license.

Which WordPress and PHP versions are supported?

The plugin needs WordPress 6.2 or newer, PHP 8.2 or newer and WooCommerce 7.0 or newer, and is tested with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce releases. Current WooCommerce versions need WordPress 7.0 or newer, so keep WordPress up to date. PHP 8.1 is no longer supported because it no longer receives security fixes. Ask your host to keep PHP on the latest updates.
sections.changelog:
1.0.361 (2026-10-22)

  • Changed: The plugin now needs PHP 8.2 or newer. PHP 8.1 no longer receives security fixes. If your site still runs PHP 8.1, ask your host to move it to 8.2 or newer before updating
  • Added: Trial bookings now record when you marked them as contacted. The date shows under the status on the Trial Classes screen, in the booking details and in the report
  • Fixed (Premium): The Reports tab on the Trial Classes screen showed nothing when you clicked Generate Report, and Export CSV downloaded an empty file. Both work again, and the report now counts and filters contacted bookings
  • Fixed: Filtering the Trial Classes list by “Contacted” showed every booking instead of only contacted ones
  • Fixed: Add Member could only link a member to an existing WordPress user. You can again create a new WordPress account for the member, or leave the user empty to keep the member under your account with their email saved for later
  • Fixed: Settings → User Accounts listed no members and its “Create users” button did nothing. It lists members kept under an administrator account again and creates their logins, linking brothers and sisters who share an email to one account
  • Fixed: Bulk Archive and Activate on the Members screen did nothing, and the “members archived” message never appeared
  • Fixed (Premium): Data → Export “Include Photos” produced a plain JSON file without photos, and ZIP files could not be imported. Both work again
  • Fixed (Premium): Event notification emails accept several comma-separated addresses again
  • Fixed (Premium): The Group and Membership Type columns of the class enrolment CSV were empty
  • Fixed: Some admin messages showed “undefined” (Page Access and Training Videos) and others were not translated
  • Fixed: Activating or updating the free version could write “Failed opening” PHP warnings to the error log
  • Fixed: The first page load after activating the plugin could log “translation loading was triggered too early” notices for this plugin and WooCommerce

1.0.360 (2026-10-21)

  • New (Premium): Activity Log — see who changed members, attendance, kiosk sign-ins and trial bookings, with filters, CSV export, retention and privacy tools.
  • Added: Bulk actions on the Belt Colors screen. Tick several belts and activate or deactivate them in one go
  • Added (Premium): Add belts to a group, replace their groups, or remove them from a group in bulk. Removing a belt’s last group makes it available to everyone, and the confirmation says so
  • Added: Bulk actions on the Trial Classes screen. Tick several bookings and mark them contacted, confirmed, completed, cancelled or pending, or delete them
  • Added (Premium): Bulk actions on the Classes screen: archive or restore classes, assign or remove an instructor, and change location. Archived classes keep their enrolments
  • Fixed (Premium): Archived classes kept sending “class starts soon” reminders to enrolled members. Archiving now stops them, and restoring a class turns them back on
  • Added (Premium): Bulk activate or deactivate instructors on the Instructors screen. Deactivated instructors keep their current classes
  • Fixed: The Confirm and Cancel buttons on trial class bookings showed “An error occurred” and did nothing. They work again
  • Fixed (Premium): Editing a member on the Members screen did not show or save their groups, and saving removed any groups they already had (since 1.0.356). Check the groups of members edited since then
  • Fixed: On sites using object caching (for example Memcached), a belt that had just been renamed, deactivated or deleted could still be accepted under its old key for a few minutes
  • Fixed (Premium): If saving a belt’s groups failed part-way, the belt could end up with no groups, making it available to every group. The belt is now left as it was and the error is reported

1.0.359 (2026-10-08)

This release also contains 1.0.358, which was prepared but never published separately — if you are updating from 1.0.357, all of the below is new to you.

  • Added: Instructors can reopen sign-in for a class that is running late. In Instructor Mode on the kiosk, a “Reopen sign-in” button appears once a class is past its sign-in cutoff; one tap lets students keep signing in for the rest of that session, and the class locks again as normal next time
  • Added: New Late Sign-In Grace setting (default 30 minutes) controls how long after a class’s scheduled end students can still sign in
  • Fixed: Name, PIN and bulk sign-in now follow the same late cutoff as QR sign-in. Previously a student could be refused by QR scan but signed in by name at the same moment
  • Fixed: Classes that run past midnight (for example 11:00 PM to 12:30 AM) now work on the kiosk. Before, they could not be saved, and the kiosk could not find them before or after midnight
  • Fixed: Attendance for a class that runs past midnight is recorded on the date the class started, so one session’s register is no longer split across two days and a student cannot be signed in twice either side of midnight
  • Improved: Class times are checked as a duration. An end time earlier than the start is treated as running past midnight, and anything over 12 hours is rejected as a likely typo
  • Fixed: Activating the plugin from the Plugins screen failed with “Plugin could not be activated because it triggered a fatal error” (since 1.0.356). Updating an already active plugin was not affected
  • Fixed: The kiosk page at /kiosk/ could show “Page not found” after the plugin was reactivated, until permalinks were re-saved. The kiosk address now repairs itself on the next page load
  • Updated: Freemius SDK to 2.13.5
  • Compatibility: Verified against WordPress 7.1.3 and WooCommerce 11.2.1

1.0.357 (2026-09-09)

  • Improved: QR sign-in now records attendance against the class you have selected on the kiosk, instead of guessing from the time. When two classes overlap, scans go to the class you picked rather than the one the clock suggests
  • Added: A warning now appears on the plugin’s screens if your WordPress timezone is not set, or is set to a fixed offset such as “UTC+1” rather than a city. Class times, attendance and scheduling are all compared against that setting, and a fixed offset looks correct until the clocks change. Choosing a city such as London or New York handles daylight saving for you

1.0.356 (2026-08-27)

  • Fixed: Class times displayed an hour or more out on the Class Register, Member Area, trial booking pages and kiosk whenever your site was not set to UTC. A class saved as 6:00 PM now shows as 6:00 PM everywhere. Your existing classes are unchanged — only the display was affected
  • Fixed: Dates and times recorded by the plugin (member joined, attendance taken, booking received) could be saved an hour or more out on some hosting, because they were stamped by the database server’s clock rather than your site’s. All new timestamps now use your WordPress timezone
  • Fixed: The Recent Attendance “Time” column on the dashboard showed 12:00 AM on every row instead of the actual sign-in time
  • Fixed: The Recent Trial Bookings time on the dashboard could show the wrong hour on some hosting
  • Fixed: A class scheduled inside the hour the clocks skip forward on a daylight-saving change could never be picked up by the kiosk
  • Compatibility: Verified against WordPress 7.1 final
  • Fixed: Plugin admin styles and scripts no longer load on screens the plugin does not own — they previously loaded on every wp-admin page, including the post editor
  • Fixed: Row actions (Edit, Trash, View) in WordPress’s own Posts, Pages, Users and Plugins lists are no longer forced permanently visible by this plugin — they hover as WordPress intends again. Inside the plugin’s own screens they stay visible as before
  • Fixed: Styling on the Belt Colours, License Reminders and Members pages could fail to load, leaving those screens looking unformatted
  • Improved: Member photos now accept WebP, so pictures from newer phones work, and the file type is checked from the file itself rather than what the browser reports
  • Improved: One consistent rule for every date and time in the plugin, protected by automated tests so it cannot drift again
  • Improved: The media library is no longer loaded on admin pages that never use it, and database maintenance checks no longer run while rendering admin notices
  • Note: existing records are untouched and display exactly as before; only newly saved dates use the corrected clock
  • Note: if your timezone is set to a “UTC+1” style offset under Settings > General, consider switching to a city such as London or New York so daylight saving is handled for you

short_description: Complete management system for martial arts clubs including member management, class scheduling, and attendance tracking. Requires WooCommerce.
description:
Martial Arts Club Manager is a comprehensive WordPress plugin designed specifically for martial arts club owners, dojo managers, and gym operators who need a professional system to manage their students, classes, and operations.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Karate dojos and martial arts schools
  • Taekwondo, Judo, Jiu-Jitsu, and other martial arts clubs
  • Fitness centers offering martial arts classes
  • Sports clubs needing member and class management
  • Any organization requiring attendance tracking and membership management

Free Features

Member Management
* Add unlimited members to user accounts
* Detailed member profiles with photo, belt color, weight, height
* Basic membership type management
* Member status management (active/inactive)
* Date of birth and personal information tracking
* Export member data to CSV
* “By User” view that groups members under their family account, with bulk actions: set active/inactive, change membership, assign belt, send email and export
* Printable membership cards

Belt Colors
* Set up your own belt colors and their order
* Activate or deactivate several belts at once with bulk actions

Trial Class Booking
* Public booking form for prospective students
* Admin notification emails with applicant details
* Customizable success messages
* Manage trial bookings from admin panel
* Track each booking from pending to contacted, confirmed and completed
* Bulk actions: mark several bookings contacted, confirmed, completed, cancelled or pending, or delete them
* Convert trial students to members easily

WooCommerce Integration
* Associate members with product purchases
* Mark products as “dojo products” requiring member selection
* Display member information in cart and checkout
* Seamless integration with WooCommerce workflows
* Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage and the Cart and Checkout blocks

Admin Dashboard (Basic)
* Member list with sorting and filtering
* Belt distribution analytics
* Membership type breakdown
* Recent members view
* Recent trial bookings
* Settings and customization
* WordPress dashboard widgets: upcoming member birthdays, membership overview and members by belt color
* Warns you if your site timezone is missing or set to a fixed offset, which would shift class times when the clocks change

Frontend Member Area
* View and edit member profiles
* Upload member photos
* Manage personal information
* Access member cards

Data Tools
* Export your club data as a full JSON backup or as CSV files
* Import a backup into the same or another site, with options for matching users and handling duplicates
* Reset plugin data to start again

Pro Features (Premium License)

Advanced Member Management
* Multi-club support for franchise operations
* Group assignments for organizing students
* License expiration tracking with automated reminders
* Belt grading history tracking
* Club and group filtering in member lists
* Belt color groups: limit belts to groups such as Kids or Adults, and add or remove belts from groups in bulk
* Assign groups and enroll in classes from the “By User” view

Class Scheduling & Management 🔒
* Create and manage unlimited classes
* Schedule classes by day, time, and location
* Weekly, every-other-week and monthly classes
* Classes that run past midnight
* Multi-day classes that share one roster
* Multiple location support
* Assign groups to specific classes
* Enroll members in classes
* Class capacity management, with a waitlist that promotes members automatically when a place opens
* Archive old classes while preserving history
* Bulk actions: archive or restore classes, assign or remove instructors, and change location

Kiosk Sign-In 🔒
* Full-screen tablet sign-in for your dojo entrance
* Members sign in by searching their name, with a 6-digit PIN, or by scanning their personal QR code
* QR codes on printed membership cards and in the Member Area
* Instructor Mode for signing in a whole class and reopening sign-in for a class that is running late
* Late Sign-In Grace setting controls how long after a class ends students can still sign in

Instructors & Private Bookings 🔒
* Instructor profiles with photos, assigned to classes
* Activate or deactivate instructors in bulk
* Instructor availability with weekly slots and date-specific changes
* Public booking form for private lessons, with payment through WooCommerce or admin confirmation

Syllabus & Grading Progress 🔒
* Publish grading requirements for each belt, with descriptions, videos and PDFs
* Instructors sign off each requirement for each member
* Members see their own syllabus and progress on any page you add the syllabus to

Activity Log 🔒
* See who changed what and when: members, belts, groups, attendance, kiosk sign-ins, trial bookings, bulk actions and imports
* Filter by date, area, person or member, and export to CSV
* Choose how long entries are kept
* Works with WordPress’s personal data export and erase tools

Attendance Tracking 🔒
* Quick attendance recording for each class
* View and modify historical attendance records
* Comprehensive attendance reports
* Export attendance data to CSV
* Filter by class, member, or date range
* Attendance trends analytics (6 months)

Events Management 🔒
* Create and manage martial arts events (tournaments, seminars, gradings)
* Multiple member registration per event
* Registration closing dates
* Event status tracking (upcoming, ongoing, completed)
* Email notifications for registrations
* Export event registrations to CSV
* Archive events when complete
* Member event history tracking

Training Videos 🔒
* Organize training videos by belt level
* Filter videos by category, difficulty, and instructor
* Restrict access based on membership type
* Video thumbnail and description support
* YouTube and Vimeo integration
* Progress tracking

Communication Tools 🔒
* Send bulk emails to all members or filtered groups
* Filter recipients by membership type, group, or status
* Email preview before sending
* Customizable email templates with header/footer
* Button color customization for branded emails

Page Access Control 🔒
* Restrict pages to logged-in users only
* Set membership-level restrictions
* Create premium content areas
* Custom redirect rules

Enhanced Dashboard 🔒
* Active classes statistics
* Monthly attendance overview
* Upcoming events widget
* Expiring licenses alerts
* Attendance trends chart
* Advanced analytics

Requirements

This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active. WooCommerce is used for handling product purchases and member associations during checkout.

Language Support

  • Fully internationalized and translation-ready
  • Text domain: martial-arts-club-manager
  • POT file included for translators

Documentation

The full user manual is online at https://www.martialartsclubmanager.com/user-documentation/ and is linked from the plugin’s dashboard (View Documentation).

Support

For support and questions, please visit the WordPress.org support forums for this plugin.

For bug reports, please include:
* WordPress version
* WooCommerce version
* PHP version
* Description of the issue
* Steps to reproduce

Credits

Martial Arts Club Manager is developed and maintained by madebyeli.com.

Privacy Policy

Martial Arts Club Manager stores member information in your WordPress database. This information includes:
* Member names and contact details
* Date of birth
* Belt colors and membership information
* Attendance records
* Event registrations
* Trial booking requests

All data is stored locally on your WordPress installation. The plugin does not send any data to external servers. You are responsible for complying with privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) in your jurisdiction.

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with:
* WooCommerce (required) – For product purchases and checkout
* YouTube/Vimeo (optional) – For embedding training videos (if you use the training videos feature)

When using training videos with embedded YouTube or Vimeo content, those platforms may collect data according to their privacy policies. Please review YouTube and Vimeo privacy policies if you use this feature.

Also verified against WordPress 7.1. Your existing classes and records are unchanged; only the display was affected. Recommended for all users.

Recommended for all users.

upgrade_notice.1.0.193: Enhanced email reliability, improved code quality, and better WordPress compatibility. Recommended upgrade for all users.
